title: 第1563章 暗流12第1562章 暗流11
content_zh:
闻言，张佛教授低低轻笑一声，嘴角勾起一抹深沉又精明的弧度，脸上满是运筹帷幄的得意神色。他语气轻描淡写，看似随口一提，话语深处却藏着极致的算计与城府：“我从未和他们讲枯燥的科学理论，也从未试图改变他们的信仰。”他微微抬眸，眼底闪过一丝狡黠，“我只是给了他们一个根本无法拒绝的美好期许。我向所有亚特王朝的族人承诺，我会动用毕生所学与所有资源，将这座沉没深海千年、被海水掩埋的古老王朝，完整从幽暗深海之中抬出，让尘封的神殿、古迹与文明，尽数重见天日。”
就在二人深入交谈、谜团层层解开的关键时刻，房间紧闭的木门被轻轻推开。一名身姿挺拔、身着规整制服的卫兵跨步走入房间，神情肃穆、步履沉稳，带着十足的纪律感。他没有多余的动作，快步径直走到张佛教授身侧，微微俯身，压低声音，在教授耳边低声禀报着要事，神色恭敬又凝重，显然是传来了紧急消息。
张佛教授耐心听完卫兵的低语，神色微顿，轻轻颔首示意知晓。随后他转头看向身侧的作家，眼底带着几分歉意，抬手轻轻示意，语气平和地说道：“稍等，作家，我暂且处理一点急事。”
话音落下，他便跟着卫兵转身匆匆离去。两人的身影刚消失在门口，一道纤细轻盈的身影便小心翼翼地从走廊拐角快步凑了过来。是女孩阿让，她步履急促，神色慌张，刻意放轻了脚步，生怕被旁人察觉。她抬眼看向独自留在房间内的作家，带着忐忑与急切，低声轻轻唤了一声：“作家？”
作家瞬间捕捉到她声音里的异常，那平静温和的嗓音里，藏着压不住的慌张与焦灼。他立刻转头望向阿让，敏锐察觉到出事了，语气瞬间紧绷，连忙问道：“怎么了？是不是出什么意外了？”
阿让的脸色一片紧绷，白皙的脸颊毫无血色，眼底盛满了藏不住的慌张与焦急，双手不自觉微微攥紧。她刻意压低语速，用只有两人能听见的音量，急促又紧张地说道：“是你们带来的那个女人，波丽！这里的人马上就要对她施行鱼手术了，情况很紧急！”
“鱼手术？”陌生诡异的名词瞬间砸进作家的脑海，他心头猛地一震，大脑骤然一片空白，一时间根本无法理解这究竟是何种诡异的仪式与操作。极致的危机感瞬间席卷全身，后背瞬间泛起一层凉意，他清楚这绝非普通手术，定然凶险万分。来不及细细思索其中的蹊跷，他满脑子都是救人，立刻急促地追问阿让：“阿让，你知不知道这片区域的能源总控在哪里？有没有办法直接切断这里的能源供给？”他下意识想着切断能源，或许就能中止这场诡异的手术。
突如其来的问题让阿让彻底愣住了，她眨了眨眼，满脸茫然与懵懂，完全无法理解“能源”是什么，也不明白此刻为何要提及此事。她微微歪头，疑惑地轻声反问：“能源？什么能源？我听不懂……”
看到阿让全然不解的模样，作家瞬间反应过来，自己情急之下问错了方向。他立刻放弃了切断能源的思路，此刻所有的杂念都被抛开，救下波丽成了唯一的念头。他收敛了慌乱，眼神变得格外凝重恳切，带着一丝恳求的意味看向阿让，语速放缓却无比坚定地嘱托道：“算了，不用管这个了。你现在立刻悄悄回到波丽的身边，暗中守着她，不要惊动任何人。一旦找到合适的机会，就立刻带着她逃离那里，你能帮我做到吗？”
阿让定定地看着作家凝重认真、满是恳切的神情，清晰知晓了事情的严重性。她没有丝毫犹豫，用力重重地点了点头，眼神褪去慌张，多了几分坚定，轻声郑重地应下：“嗯。”
（这时的作家和张佛教授那里。
“给我个线索，教授。”作家说道。
张佛指着一张世界地图说道：“罗本西部，度飞群岛南部，西海洋海脊，这让你想到了什么？”
“海底神殿的古老传说，但那是不可能的，那只是个传说。”作家皱眉说道。
“继续，继续，作家。”张佛得意的让作家往下说。
“我们在古老的王国，亚特王朝！”作家突然想到那个传说中的海底之国。
“是的，是的，这不正是完成我工作的完美地方吗？”张佛教授说道。
“但你是怎么让他们接受你的？”作家奇怪的问道。“难道科学与古代神殿的仪式和偶像崇拜不是对立的吗？”
“我给了他们一颗糖，我答应要把亚特王朝从海里抬出来。”张佛教授得意的说。
这时一个卫兵走进房间，示意张佛教授到他跟前。

“嗯，怎么了？抱歉，作家。”张佛教授对作家示意道。
他刚走开，女孩阿让就过来叫住作家：“作家？”
“怎么了？”作家好奇的问。
“是你们的那个女人，他们要对她进行鱼手术。”阿让紧张又焦急的说道。
content_en:
Hearing this, Professor Zhang Fo chuckled softly, with a deep and shrewd arc at the corner of his mouth, and a proud look of strategizing on his face. His tone was understated and seemed to be mentioned casually, but there was extreme calculation and calculation hidden deep in his words: "I never talked to them about boring scientific theories, and I never tried to change their beliefs." He raised his eyes slightly, with a hint of cunning in his eyes, "I just gave them a completely impossible I promise all the people of the At Dynasty that I will use all my life’s knowledge and resources to completely lift this ancient dynasty that has sunk into the deep sea for thousands of years and been buried by the sea, so that all the dusty temples, monuments and civilizations can be brought back to light.”
At the critical moment when the two were having an in-depth conversation and the mysteries were being solved layer by layer, the closed wooden door of the room was gently pushed open. A tall and tall guard wearing a regular uniform strode into the room with a solemn expression, steady steps, and a full sense of discipline. Without any extra movement, he walked quickly to Professor Zhang Fo's side, leaned slightly, lowered his voice, and whispered something important in the professor's ear. His expression was respectful and solemn. It was obvious that urgent news had been sent.
After Professor Zhang Fo patiently listened to the guard's whispers, he paused slightly and nodded slightly to show his understanding. Then he turned to look at the writer beside him, with a hint of apology in his eyes. He raised his hand to signal gently and said in a calm tone: "Wait a moment, writer. I'm going to take care of some urgent matters for now."
As soon as he finished speaking, he turned and hurried away with the guard. As soon as the two figures disappeared from the door, a slender and light figure cautiously walked over from the corner of the corridor. It was the girl Arang. She walked hastily and looked panicked. She deliberately walked lightly for fear of being noticed by others. She raised her eyes to look at the writer who was left alone in the room. With anxiety and eagerness, she called softly in a low voice: "Writer?"
The writer instantly captured the abnormality in her voice. In that calm and gentle voice, there was uncontrollable panic and anxiety. He immediately turned his head to look at Arang. He was keenly aware that something had happened. His tone was tense and he quickly asked: "What's wrong? Was there an accident?"
Arang's face was tense, his fair cheeks were bloodless, his eyes were filled with uncontrollable panic and anxiety, and his hands were clenched slightly unconsciously. She deliberately lowered her speaking speed and said quickly and nervously at a volume that only the two of them could hear: "It's the woman you brought, Polly! The people here are about to perform fish surgery on her. The situation is very urgent!"
"Fish surgery?" The strange and strange term suddenly hit the writer's mind. His heart was shocked, and his brain suddenly went blank. For a while, he couldn't understand what kind of strange ritual and operation it was. The ultimate sense of crisis swept through his body instantly, and a chill instantly spread down his back. He knew that this was no ordinary surgery, and it must be extremely dangerous. He didn't have time to think carefully about the strangeness. He was preoccupied with saving people, and immediately asked Arang hurriedly: "Arang, do you know where the main energy control in this area is? Is there a way to directly cut off the energy supply here?" He subconsciously thought that cutting off the energy might be able to abort this strange operation.
Arang was completely stunned by the sudden question. She blinked, her face full of confusion and confusion. She couldn't understand what "energy" was, and she didn't understand why she was mentioning it at this moment. She tilted her head slightly and asked softly in confusion: "Energy? What energy? I don't understand..."
Seeing Arang's completely confused look, the writer instantly realized that he had asked in the wrong direction out of desperation. He immediately gave up the idea of ​​cutting off the energy source. At this moment, all distracting thoughts were thrown away, and saving Polly became his only thought. He calmed down his panic, his eyes became extra solemn and sincere, and he looked at Arang with a hint of pleading. His words slowed down but he said firmly: "Forget it, don't worry about this. You are nowHe immediately quietly returned to Polly's side and guarded her secretly without disturbing anyone. Once you find the right opportunity, take her and escape from there immediately. Can you help me do that? "
Arang looked at the writer's solemn, serious and sincere expression, and clearly understood the seriousness of the matter. She didn't hesitate at all, nodded vigorously, her eyes lost her panic, became a little more determined, and responded softly and solemnly: "Yes. "
(At this time, the writer and Professor Zhang Fo were there.
"Give me a clue, professor," said the writer.
Zhang Fo pointed to a world map and said: "West of Robben, south of Dufei Islands, and the ridge of the Western Ocean. What does this remind you of?"
"The ancient legend of the underwater temple, but that is impossible, it is just a legend." The writer frowned and said.
"Continue, continue, writer." Zhang Fo proudly asked the writer to continue.
"We are in the ancient kingdom, the At Dynasty!" The writer suddenly thought of the legendary underwater country.
"Yes, yes, isn't this the perfect place to complete my work?" Professor Zhang Fo said.
"But how did you get them to accept you?" the writer asked strangely. “Isn’t science antithetical to the rites and idolatry of the ancient temples?”
"I gave them a candy, and I promised to lift the At Dynasty out of the sea." Professor Zhang Fo said proudly.
At this time, a guard walked into the room and motioned Professor Zhang Fo to come to him.
"Well, what's wrong? Sorry, writer." Professor Zhang Fo gestured to the writer.
As soon as he walked away, the girl Arang came over and called the writer: "Writer?"
"What's wrong?" the writer asked curiously.
"It's your woman, they want to perform fish surgery on her." Arang said nervously and anxiously.
